svg.text: qenb = VSS: Q tap copy always on
ua pins -> two-stage LNA -> I / Q passive mixers (LO: ls and the a2 tap, 72 deg apart) -> baseband (LPF ~145 kHz, HPF ~9 kHz) -> limiter + comparator -> q_i / q_q (uo[4] / uo[5])
about 7 mA at tt; the RP2350 PIO decodes q_i / q_q as a quadrature counter; source: sim/rx/rx_top.py
